import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 60;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long n;
    static int k;

    static class Matrix {
        int n;
        int[][] a = new int[MAXN][MAXN];

        void init() {
            for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; j++) {
                    a[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        void set() {
            init();
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                a[i][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix rhs) {
            Matrix ans = new Matrix();
            ans.n = n;
            long[][] tmp = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
            final long MODLL = MOD * MOD;
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    tmp[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
                    for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                        tmp[i][j] += (long) a[i][k] * rhs.a[k][j];
                        if (tmp[i][j] >= MODLL) {
                            tmp[i][j] -= MODLL;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                    ans.a[i][j] = (int) (tmp[i][j] % MOD);
                }
            }
            return ans;
        }
    }

    static Matrix[][] f = new Matrix[80][MAXN];
    static Matrix[][] sump = new Matrix[80][MAXN];
    static Matrix[][] sums = new Matrix[80][MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        k = sc.nextInt();

        int[] num = new int[80];
        int cnt = 0;
        long tempN = n;
        while (tempN != 0) {
            num[++cnt] = (int) (tempN % k);
            tempN /= k;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            f[0][i] = new Matrix();
            f[0][i].n = k + 1;
            f[0][i].set();
            for (int j = 1; j <= k + 1; j++) {
                f[0][i].a[j][j] = 1;
                f[0][i].a[i + 1][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        // Initialize sump[0][i] and sums[0][i]
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            sump[0][i] = new Matrix();
            sump[0][i].n = k + 1;
            sump[0][i].init();
            for (int j = 1; j <= k + 1; j++) {
                sump[0][i].a[j][j] = 1;
            }
        }
        // For sums[0][k-1]
        sums[0][k - 1] = new Matrix();
        sums[0][k - 1].n = k + 1;
        sums[0][k - 1].init();
        for (int j = 1; j <= k + 1; j++) {
            sums[0][k - 1].a[j][j] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < k; i++) {
            sump[0][i] = multiplyMatrices(f[0][i], sump[0][i - 1]);
        }

        for (int i = k - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            sums[0][i] = multiplyMatrices(sums[0][i + 1], f[0][i]);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < cnt; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                if (j == 0) {
                    f[i][j] = sums[i - 1][j];
                } else {
                    f[i][j] = multiplyMatrices(sump[i - 1][j - 1], sums[i - 1][j]);
                }
            }

            sump[i][0] = f[i][0];
            sums[i][k - 1] = f[i][k - 1];

            for (int j = 1; j < k; j++) {
                sump[i][j] = multiplyMatrices(f[i][j], sump[i][j - 1]);
            }

            for (int j = k - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                sums[i][j] = multiplyMatrices(sums[i][j + 1], f[i][j]);
            }
        }

        Matrix ans = new Matrix();
        ans.n = k + 1;
        ans.set();

        int sumMod = 0;
        for (int i = cnt; i >= 1; i--) {
            for (int j = 0; j < num[i]; j++) {
                ans = multiplyMatrices(f[i - 1][(sumMod + j) % k], ans);
            }
            sumMod += num[i];
            sumMod %= k;
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k + 1; i++) {
            res = (res + ans.a[i][k + 1]) % (int) MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }

    static Matrix multiplyMatrices(Matrix a, Matrix b) {
        return a.multiply(b);
    }
}
